requiredOwnerFollowons.scope: Multiple EC/RSA EVP_PKEY_get_bn_param calls write raw BIGNUM outputs before constructing BignumPtr owners. Short-circuit failures can leave earlier successful allocations unowned; RSA optional CRT extraction also returns before adoption. Move each produced output into RAII immediately in a separately reviewed cut.

Decoded HMAC JWK std::string and JS strings; RSA/EC private component strings; BIGNUM and OpenSSL internal copies; vector intermediate construction/storage beyond logical size are not covered by SecretByteVectorDeleter. No all-copies erasure claim.

Existing data->size()*8 can overflow and EVP_PKEY_new_mac_key accepts int length while keyData.size() is size_t. Existing vector/new under -fno-exceptions has no new recoverable allocation-failure guarantee; no new cap or error parity is asserted.
